page.layout: One page of text. Woodcut ornamental border at the top, then the dedication heading in italic and capitals, then the body in roman type, a closing italic line, and the signature at right. No margin notes. No running head, catchword or signature mark.

main_text.head: Magnificentissimo, Prudentissimo & Consultissimo Viro, Domino DN. SAMUELI FRISCHINGIO, Illustris-Reipubl. Bernensis Consuli gravis-simo, Patriæ Patri optimo, Mœcenati suo clementissimo, ac susceptori è Sacro Baptismatis fonte in æternum colendo.
main_text.p: Reverendis item, Clarissimis, Doctissimisque VIRIS, D. D. Antistiti, Pastoribus, Diaconis, Professoribus Gymnasiarchæ, vigilantissimis, acutissimis, solertissimis, Ecclesiæ Scholæque Bernensis luminaribus, fautoribus, promotoribus & post DEUM patribus venerandis, suspiciendis.

p.i: Hasce studiorum suorum Theologicorum primitias sacras merito esse vult

page.notes: The faint mirrored text in the lower half of the page (a title block with "Ecclesiæ Scholæque Bernensis", "Typographus" and "M DC. LXXIV") and the show-through of the other side are not printed on this page and are left out. A faint mark at the top left corner may be a page number but is too unclear to read, so no page number is given. The woodcut border is decoration and is not transcribed. The signature line "JOH. JACOBUS HALLERUS." is set in small capitals in the print and is transcribed in capitals.
